expected_value_creation: Make policy changes, affected historical decisions, staleness, revalidation requirements, and outcomes reproducible without automatically authorizing a new policy.
beneficiary: QIF users, AI agents, accountable governance owners, operators, and affected stakeholders
supporting_evidence: NIST treats production drift as divergence from original assumptions and limitations requiring monitoring and intervention.
Recent agent governance work treats path-dependent policies and evolving organizational state as runtime governance concerns.
success_criteria: Every drift assessment resolves old and new policy snapshots and exact changed dimensions.
Every materially affected decision receives a governed revalidation outcome or remains explicitly stale.
